task.question: What is the maximum sentence given to those convicted for the assassination of Marielle Franco in Brazil on 25 February 2026?
task.evidence: 25 February – The Supreme Federal Court convicts five people, including police chief Rivaldo Barbosa and politicians Chiquinho Brazão and his brother Domingos Brazão, for the 2018 assassination of Rio de Janeiro city councilor Marielle Franco and her driver and sentences them to up to 76 years' imprisonment.
task.sonnet_answer: 78 years (the maximum sentence handed down to those convicted, including Domingos Brazão and Chiquinho Brazão, at the trial concluded on 25 February 2025)
